ei.title: Employees tend to leave companies to become founders when...
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Employees tend to leave companies to become founders when their employers' growth rates begin to fall, reducing the attractiveness of staying there and the opportunity costs of becoming founders. The likelihood of an employee leaving to become a founder has also been linked to the employee's own performance. Employees whose performance was in the middle of the distribution were the least likely to leave; the most likely were the poor-performing employees (the "slugs" whose pay wasn't high and who had the least to lose by leaving to found a startup) and the high-performing employees (the "stars" who had the potential to earn high wages by becoming self-employed). Although high-paid employees may be less likely than lower-paid employees to walk away from their salaries, if they have saved a high percentage of their earnings over the years, that nest egg may make them more likely to make the leap than if they hadn't saved.

❌ ③ average(평균적인): 반대가 아닌 중간 지점
❌ ④ struggling(고군분투하는): poor-performing에 가까운 부정적 뉘앙스
det.tip: poor-performing ↔ high-performing. '성과가 낮은' vs '성과가 높은'의 대비이다. 본문에서 두 그룹 모두 떠날 가능성이 높다고 설명한다.

questions.passage:
(A) Employees tend to leave companies to become founders when their employers' growth rates begin to fall.

(B) Please leave your bags at the reception before entering the conference room.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 leave의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 떠나다 (leave a company) / (B) 맡기다, 두다 (leave something at a place)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)는 '남기다'가 아니라 회사를 '떠나다'라는 의미
❌ ② (B)는 '떠나다'가 아니라 가방을 접수처에 '두다/맡기다'
❌ ③ (A)는 '놔두다'가 아니라 '떠나다'
✅ ④ (A) leave companies = '회사를 떠나다' / (B) leave your bags = '가방을 두다/맡기다'
det.tip: leave는 '떠나다(depart from)', '두다/맡기다(put/deposit)', '남기다(leave behind)' 등 다의어이다. 본문에서는 employees leave companies(직원이 회사를 떠나다)로 쓰였다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the probable chance that something will happen or be the case"

det.analysis:
✅ ② likelihood(가능성): 무언가가 일어날 개연적 기회라는 정의에 정확히 부합한다
❌ ① performance(성과): 수행이나 업무 결과를 의미하며 정의와 다름
❌ ③ distribution(분포): 배분이나 나눔을 의미하며 정의와 다름
❌ ④ attractiveness(매력): 끌리는 성질을 의미하며 정의와 다름
det.tip: likelihood = probability = chance. 본문에서는 The likelihood of an employee leaving(직원이 떠날 가능성)으로 쓰였다.

questions.passage: The likelihood of an employee leaving to become a founder has also been __________ (link) to the employee's own performance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 과거분사 형태가 필요하다 — has been + 과거분사 현재완료 수동태.
det.analysis: has been 다음에 과거분사가 와서 현재완료 수동태를 만든다. 가능성이 직원 성과에 '연관되어 왔다(has been linked)'이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사 'linked'로 바꿔야 한다.
det.tip: 동사 link → 과거분사 linked. has been linked to(~에 연관되어 왔다)는 현재완료 수동태 구문이다.

questions.passage: Employees tend to leave companies to become founders when their employers' growth rates begin to fall, __________ (reduce) the attractiveness of staying there and the opportunity costs of becoming founders.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 주절(Employees tend to leave...)의 결과/부대상황을 나타내는 분사구문이다. 성장률이 하락하면서 매력을 '줄이는' 것이므로 능동 의미의 현재분사 'reducing'으로 바꿔야 한다. 콤마 뒤에 위치한 결과적 분사구문이다.
det.tip: 동사 reduce → 현재분사 reducing. 콤마 뒤의 분사구문(~, reducing...)으로 주절의 결과를 나타낸다.

questions.passage: Employees tend to leave companies to become founders when their employers' growth rates begin to fall, reducing the attractiveness of staying there and the __________ of becoming founders. The likelihood of an employee leaving to become a founder has also been linked to the employee's own performance. Employees whose performance was in the middle of the distribution were the least likely to leave; the most likely were the poor-performing employees (the "slugs" whose pay wasn't high and who had the least to lose by leaving to found a startup) and the high-performing employees (the "stars" who had the potential to earn high wages by becoming self-employed). Although high-paid employees may be less likely than lower-paid employees to walk away from their salaries, if they have saved a high percentage of their earnings over the years, that nest egg may make them more likely to make the leap than if they hadn't saved.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기회 비용 — 창업의 기회 비용을 줄인다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ① opportunity costs(기회 비용): 성장률 하락이 머무는 매력과 창업의 '기회 비용'을 줄인다는 원문에 부합한다.
❌ ② salary levels(급여 수준): 본문에서 급여는 뒤에서 별도로 논의되며, 이 문맥에서는 창업의 비용이 핵심
❌ ③ growth rates(성장률): 성장률은 원인이며, 빈칸에 다시 들어가면 논리가 순환됨
❌ ④ startup risks(창업 위험): 본문에서 위험이 아닌 '기회 비용' 개념을 사용
det.tip: opportunity costs of becoming founders(창업자가 되는 기회 비용)는 직원이 회사를 떠나는 경제적 판단 요소를 설명한다.

questions.passage: Employees tend to leave companies to become founders when their employers' growth rates begin to fall, reducing the attractiveness of staying there and the opportunity costs of becoming founders. The likelihood of an employee leaving to become a founder has also been linked to the employee's own performance. Employees whose performance was in the middle of the distribution were the least likely to leave; the most likely were the poor-performing employees (the "slugs" whose pay wasn't high and who had the least to lose by leaving to found a startup) and the high-performing employees (the "stars" who had the potential to earn high wages by becoming self-employed). Although high-paid employees may be less likely than lower-paid employees to walk away from their salaries, if they have saved a high percentage of their earnings over the years, that __________ may make them more likely to make the leap than if they hadn't saved.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 목돈/비상금 — 저축한 돈이 도약하게 해줄 수 있다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ③ nest egg(목돈, 비상금): 수년간 저축한 소득의 높은 비율이 '목돈'이 되어 도약할 가능성을 높인다는 원문에 부합한다.
❌ ① high wage(높은 임금): 저축한 돈을 가리키는 것이며, 현재 임금이 아님
❌ ② pay raise(임금 인상): 저축된 자금과 임금 인상은 다른 개념
❌ ④ job offer(일자리 제안): 본문은 저축한 돈이 창업 결심의 자본이 된다는 이야기임
det.tip: nest egg(목돈, 비상금)는 관용어로, 장기간 저축하여 모은 돈을 의미한다. 본문에서 이 목돈이 창업으로의 도약을 가능하게 한다고 설명한다.
